skills.name: Limit evaluation
skills.description: Evaluating limits by direct substitution, factoring, or rationalizing.

skills.name: Continuity
skills.description: Determining whether a function is continuous at a point using the limit definition.

skills.name: Sign handling
skills.description: Tracking negative signs correctly through multi-step algebraic manipulation.

skills.name: Power rule
skills.description: Differentiating polynomial terms of the form x^n.

skills.name: Product rule
skills.description: Differentiating a product of two functions, f(x)g(x).

skills.name: Quotient rule
skills.description: Differentiating a ratio of two functions, f(x)/g(x).

skills.name: Trig derivatives
skills.description: Differentiating sin, cos, tan, and their compositions.

skills.name: Exponential derivatives
skills.description: Differentiating e^x, a^x, and their compositions.

skills.name: Implicit differentiation
skills.description: Differentiating both sides of an equation not solved for y.

skills.name: Related rates
skills.description: Relating the rates of change of two or more quantities via implicit differentiation.

skills.name: Optimization
skills.description: Finding maxima and minima of a modeled quantity using derivatives.

skills.name: Basic antiderivatives
skills.description: Reversing the power rule to find antiderivatives of polynomial terms.

skills.name: U-substitution
skills.description: Integrating a composed function by substituting for its inner function.

skills.name: Integration by parts
skills.description: Integrating a product of two functions using the by-parts formula.
